# The Initiation App

> An AI-powered iOS app that diagnoses why people with ADHD can't start tasks and delivers a personalized intervention in under 90 seconds. Built by Jarrett Siwiec in Gypsum, Colorado.

## What it is

The Initiation App is the only tool specifically designed for ADHD task initiation failure — the moment when a person knows what needs to happen, wants to do it, and still cannot start. It identifies which of 6 specific blockers is active and delivers a matched intervention and dopamine-paired reward.

The 6 blockers: fear of failure, too boring, too big, no clear start, no clear done, no urgency.

## Pricing

- Free tier: 1 session per day
- Paid: $6.99/month — unlimited sessions
- Platform: iOS only

## Blocker-specific pages

- [Fear of failure](https://www.theinitiationapp.com/adhd-fear-of-failure-tasks): Why starting feels like agreeing to be judged — stakes reduction intervention
- [Too boring](https://www.theinitiationapp.com/adhd-task-too-boring): Why ADHD brains can't start low-interest tasks — dopamine pairing intervention
- [Too big](https://www.theinitiationapp.com/adhd-task-overwhelm): Working memory overload and task freeze — scope reduction intervention
- [No urgency](https://www.theinitiationapp.com/adhd-no-urgency): Urgency dependency in ADHD — artificial urgency creation intervention
- [No clear start](https://www.theinitiationapp.com/adhd-task-paralysis-unclear-start): Task sequencing failure — action identification intervention
- [No clear done](https://www.theinitiationapp.com/adhd-no-clear-done): Open-ended task resistance — endpoint definition intervention
